programs.title: Asteroid: Final Impact
programs.desc: As the Earth is on a collision course with a deadly asteroid after a small-scale meteor shower, a discredited astrophysicist and his team race against time to hack into a state-of-the-art meteor-tracking satellite. Can he save the world?

programs.title: Gorgo
programs.desc: The classic sci-fi story of a captured baby prehistoric monster put on display in London, with giant momma monster coming to the rescue!

programs.title: The People That Time Forgot
programs.desc: In 1919, a British expedition in the Antarctica region is searching for a lost American explorer and finds a hidden prehistoric world instead.

programs.title: Heartbreakers
programs.desc: Max and Page Conners are a mother-and-daughter con team. Their cunning plan? Max singles out a wealthy man and convinces him to marry her. Once married, Page seduces the unsuspecting groom whilst ensuring  Max catches them in the an uncompromising position. Cue divorce proceedings and a large settlement. What could possibly go wrong, except maybe falling in love?

programs.title: Iron Men
programs.desc: Checking out the West Ham United journey as they relocate after over a century at Upton Park. Fans and behind-the-scenes moments capture this big move to their new stadium.

programs.title: The Walking Deceased
programs.desc: When a police officer wakes up in a hospital to find out he is in the middle of a zombie apocalypse, he will do anything to find his family, even sacrifice Twitter. The Walking Deceased is an hilarious spoof of The Walking Dead is about to spread. The story follows a group of survivors from all walks of the apocalypse - an idiotic Sheriff, his belligerent son, four squabbling friends, and a lonely zombie. They all leave their safe hideouts in search of the Safe Haven Ranch, a refuge untouched by the zombie virus.
